title: defi-dna feed output
description: What one feed adapter produces for one protocol. collect() returns the fields below, or null when the feed has nothing for that protocol; the runner adds `status` and `fetchedAt` and stores the result under data/protocols/<protocol>.json in `feeds.<feed id>`.

status.description: Added by the runner. `ok` when a value was returned, `none` when the feed has nothing (a normal answer), `error` when the source could not be read (our failure, never a statement about coverage).

value.description: The feed's headline value, verbatim and as a string: "Stage 1", "4.8/10 · medium", "82 vaults rated". Never converted into another feed's units. Its absence is what makes a cell grey.

summary.description: The feed's own text about the protocol, quoted. Never our prose about the protocol.

details.description: The parts the feed breaks its assessment into: dimensions, sub-scores, the vaults it rates. Rendered as a list, with `description` behind a dropdown.

updatedAt.description: When the feed itself last updated this assessment (ISO date or date-time). The fetch time is recorded separately as fetchedAt.

url.description: The feed's page for this protocol — where a reader checks the value.

note.description: What the data covers, or why there is none. A fact about coverage, never a judgement about the protocol.

extra.description: Optional structured data, each recognized type rendered by its own frontend component.

fetchedAt.description: Added by the runner: when we read the source.
